description: This file appears to be a C++ source code file implementing a plugin class 'LocalPlugin' for the WPEFramework. It manages loading a Rust plugin dynamically, handling communication between C++ and Rust code, and interfacing with the framework's JSON RPC system. The file includes functions for loading shared libraries, managing plugin contexts, and handling plugin lifecycle and communication.

classes.name: RequestContext
classes.description: Holds context information for a request, including channel ID and authentication token.

classes.name: PluginContext
classes.description: Contains plugin-specific context, including ID and a callback function for sending data.

classes.name: LocalPlugin
classes.description: Represents the plugin class managing Rust plugin integration, lifecycle, and communication.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, loads the shared Rust plugin library, and sets up function pointers.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, destroys the Rust plugin instance.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends JSON messages from Rust to the plugin's service, wrapping them in JSON RPC messages.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes Rust plugin methods asynchronously, passing JSON RPC requests.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Handles client connection, notifying the Rust plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, notifying the Rust plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON RPC messages for the plugin.
